name: staged_from_a_run
title: Tasks · what an agent brings in waits on one card; a No's reason reaches its next run

steps.say: keep a list of contacts: their name and email
steps.reply:
Your contact list is set up. It's called **People** and sits in a new **Contacts** module. Each contact has a **name** and an **email**.

Each email belongs to one person, so the same person won't be added twice. Each contact is also linked to anything else I know about them.

The list is empty for now. You can give me contacts here, like "add Sara Lee, sara@example.com", or paste several at once.
